history_rule: Immediately previous collected snapshot; reset after absence or gap over 180 seconds; invalid previous values treated as missing.
target_rule: First collected report at/after 10 minutes, accepted through 12; requires uninterrupted full-window follow-up.
limitations: All snapshots from one local date; may contain multiple sessions.
Overlapping examples are not independent journeys.
Historical training and live sampling differ.
Collection time is not verified source-observation time.
No retraining or historical test-set evaluation.
deployment_decision: Automatic model predictions for live trains remain disabled.
